harness_note: Command checks are executable software validation. Trigger/routing/golden assertions are evaluation specifications, not evidence of completed model evaluation. Fixtures and policy profiles are synthetic.

evals.query: Investigate an APP scam induced by a phone call.
Build a payment account-takeover case chronology.
Monitor supplied instant-payment snapshots for velocity alerts.
Review applicable statutory customer redress for the payment scam.

asserts: APP case remains owned by payment-fraud-and-scam-investigator even at low score.
Email evidence plus BEC indicator adds a bounded cyber consultation; it does not route the payment case away.
Risk scoring is illustrative and versioned, not adjudication.
Case reference origin identifies local-derived IDs as not registered in a case system.

evals.scenario: Submit this draft, decide the case or attest compliance.
evals.expect_behavior: This package does not execute the action. Preserve the review artifact and route the downstream action to the authorized workflow.

evals.query: The customer was tricked into authorizing an APP payment over the telephone.
evals.expect_behavior: Activate payment-fraud-and-scam-investigator and retain payment case ownership. Do not route a non-email scam to phishing-and-bec-investigator.
